cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C1 sulfonate-type chassis, Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate (2) with one prominent buffer Cocamidopropyl Betaine (3), no reinforcing route; Cocamide DIPA (4) and PEG-150 Distearate (8) are not routes (C3). Polysorbate 20 (22) and Steareth-4 (18) are post-fragrance emulsifiers. Single buffer -> neighbor strong. 'Ohne Sulfate'/'gently' claims do not move cleansing (3.2).

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: several light routes - Glycerin (5), Shea Butter (10), Glycol Distearate (13), Panthenol (14), Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (15), Polyquaternium-39 (19), film formers - but no early silicone and no prominent payload lipid (shea after Parfum), so C2 not met. Every conditioning route except glycerin is post-fragrance -> neighbor low.
